feedback: Remove the unconditional top-level minCount constraints for actualSectionModulus, requiredSectionModulus, actualShearArea, and requiredShearArea. They currently require quantities even when the strip is not both abreast of a hatch and serving as an ice stringer, contrary to the conditional applicability. Place those quantity paths and the two comparisons inside the applicable both-true branch (or otherwise encode the implication without imposing them on non-applicable strips). Ensure the applicability branch does not pass when a required applicability selector is absent.

The applicability quantities and comparison are now correctly confined to the both-true applicability branch, and absent applicability selectors do not pass. However, the very-long-hatch alternative has accidental pass logic: a node with veryLongHatchOpening=true can satisfy the standalone true branch without providing classification-society approval or the permitted reduced line load, making TRF055's conditional exception checks optional. Remove that standalone true alternative and encode the very-long-hatch case so that any true veryLongHatchOpening either satisfies the explicitly required approved reduced-line-load branch (0.10 <= permittedReducedLineLoad < 0.15 with approval=true) or uses a clearly represented non-reduced-load alternative if that alternative is verified; do not make mutually exclusive alternatives conjunctively mandatory.

Retain the prior conditional applicability and approved very-long-hatch branch, but the COMPLETE dependency contract declares directConstraintTerms that are omitted: designLineLoad, hatchOpeningLength, scantlingApprovalStatus, sectionModulus, and shipBreadth. Encode each on the required narrowDeckStrip owner with its canonical datatype/unit and required semantics; do not replace them with presence-only constraints. Also ensure the very-long-hatch case has a verified non-reduced-load alternative if the source semantics permit the ordinary 0.15 case; otherwise retain the approved reduced-load branch as the only true very-long alternative without allowing missing branch-selection evidence to pass.

Reject. Preserve the prior conditional applicability and approved/non-reduced very-long-hatch alternatives, but fix gen:ScantlingApprovalStatusShape: it is applied to the status value while declaring a property path back to nltl:scantlingApprovalStatus, so it targets the wrong node and can require a status value to contain another status property. Make the value shape constrain the value itself with sh:nodeKind sh:IRI, sh:class nltl:evidenceState, and the verified controlled-value set, then apply it from the narrowDeckStrip status property. Also retain and complete the prior instruction for the COMPLETE directConstraintTerms designLineLoad, hatchOpeningLength, sectionModulus, and shipBreadth: their canonical units are present, but presence-only quantity constraints do not encode their declared direct semantics; add those verified semantics without relocating them or duplicating the actual section-modulus/shear-area facts.
